title: Karbobala May Arsh
body:
karbobala may arsh ke taare bikhar gaye
maqtal may bhook o pyaas ke maare bikhar gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat thi aaftab ki ya roz e qatl e shaah
aahon se fatema ke sharaare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaysu e mushk o boo ali akbar ke raat bhar
maa ne hazaar baar saware bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe bhai dasht may farzand ran may do
mazloom ke tamaam sahare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
rudaad e teer keh na saka moo se be zaban
masoom ke fiza may ishaare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
dauda diye faras jo layeeno ne laash par
aaza hassan ke laal ke saare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache kahin hai shaam e ghariban haram kahin
aandhi chale bala ki sitaare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ko aaj tak hai un auraakh ki talaash
jo nehre alqama ke kanare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra uthaane aayi hai majlis may ay urooj
gohar jo aansuon ke hamare bikhar gaye
karbobala may arsh ke...
author: Urooj Bijnori
